Driver settings

Blasters automatically aim and fire at visible rivals ahead. Turn this off for manual F / touch fire. Missiles still use E. Weapons are disabled in Race and Time trial.

Mobile tilt steering

Hold your phone comfortably, then enable motion. Tilt left to steer left and right to steer right. Use landscape for more space.

Touch steering is available. Motion data stays on your device.

Click a key field, then press a letter. Arrow keys always work. Settings save on this device.

Find your racing line.

Accelerate / steerWASD / ↑↓←→Drift through cornersSPACEBoostSHIFTBlaster / missileF / EMine / EMP / oilQ / T / GSignature abilityX / ZCamera / pauseC / ESCRestart solo runR

On mobile, open Settings → Enable tilt, allow motion access, and calibrate while holding the phone comfortably. Tilt steers; auto-accelerate is optional. Hold BRAKE to slow or reverse. Touch joystick steering remains available. Use landscape for more room. Race and Time trial have no weapons. Combat is three laps; Elimination is last driver standing; Survival adds tougher waves.

Eight labeled pickups: Repair, Nitro, Shield, Missile reload, Rapid fire (10s), Plasma rounds (8s), Pickup magnet (12s), and Ability recharge. Pure racing modes use only repair, nitro and shields. Auto-fire detects visible rivals ahead; turn it off in Settings for manual fire. Stay on the track and cross checkpoints in order. In LAN races, mines and oil are unavailable; the pit menu does not pause other drivers.

Bring your rivals.

Play with 2–6 drivers using a self-hosted LAN server. For local multiplayer, a host runs the repository’s Node.js server and shares its address on the same Wi-Fi.

Solo play works without a server.
